headline: Quiet Saturday; scores drift as last week's news settles
body: A quiet day with no scored events. Scores shifted only by hundredths as the effects of earlier announcements faded: 1984 and Reversion ticked up slightly while the AI-takeover endings eased. Horizon Balance is 0.8, up 0.02.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Conquerors -0.05 and Descendants -0.05.
